title: NA60010: Analysis Of Ocean Structures Ii
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Wave and wave loading on ocean structures. Effects of currents and winds.
Quasi-static balance. Actual ship response. fundamental theoretical approach.
Extrapolation of measured response. Design loads and distribution. Fatigue
loading. Longitudinal response and dynamic behaviour. Efficiency of structure.
Superstructure dynamic behaviour. Slamming, whipping and springing. Design
considerations and procedures, Modes of failure. Design margins. Optimisation
techniques. Effect of geometrical discontinuities. Built-in stress
concentrations. Discontinuities in superstructures and deckhouses. Control
surfaces and shaft brackets. Online stress measurement and its use in condition
based monitoring.Response of one degree freedom idealised offshore structure.
Physical properties of dynamic analysis; mass, stiffness, damping. Concept of
added mass. Multiple degrees of freedom system, free vibration. Response of
fixed offshore structure as MDF system. Response of ships and semisubmersibles
under random wave loading. Structural stability problems including the
numerical treatment. Non-linear analysis of static and dynamic structural
problems.
